killedBy: the versus map cards (issue #274) keeps the picture and the sentence out of the card's name, and the sentence in its description
why: Folds a whole sentence into each card's accessible name, so a screen reader walking the map row reads seven paragraphs before reaching the eighth control -- and reads each one TWICE, since `aria-describedby` still points at the same node. Nothing visible moves and the sweeps in hud.a11y.test.ts pass: the name is non-empty and is not a bare digit. The same two-announcements-of-one-fact collision issue #629 called out on the achievement rows.
